raw_text_content: SpringHill Suites by Marriott Orange Beach Gulf Shores Dining. The on-property restaurants at SpringHill Suites by Marriott Orange Beach Gulf Shores are: Salt & Sips. Salt & Sips is your poolside hangout for coastal bites, easy cocktails and laid back afternoons. Come for the sips, stay for the good tides. You can view other dining options on our dining page. What cuisine is offered at SpringHill Suites by Marriott Orange Beach Gulf Shores?
